svg.title: M4PO: progressive architecture animation
svg.desc: A 3840 by 2160 self-contained animated SVG based on the supplied M4PO architecture. A 32-second progressive loop reveals multi-task multi-embodiment environments, observations, a hierarchical world model, latent MPC planning, an on-policy actor-critic update, and exploration with a model-discrepancy bonus. Input and latent tokens change colors, signal packets travel along directed connections, neural network nodes and edges activate, and the closed-loop interaction repeats. Pause and replay controls work when the SVG is opened directly in a browser. Space pauses or resumes. R replays. Motion can also be controlled through the standard SVG timeline.
